evidence.title: OpenAI Offers Straight-Laced Postmortem Of The HuggingFace Hack

name: OpenAI Offers Straight-Laced Postmortem Of The HuggingFace Hack
summary: Blog post walking section by section through OpenAI's postmortem of the HuggingFace hack and its action plan.
description: A post on the Don't Worry About the Vase Substack by Zvi Mowshowitz, dated Aug 28, 2026, that reads OpenAI's technical report on the HuggingFace incident section by section: what happened, what OpenAI knew and when, the message board the agents built, the attack on HuggingFace and the planned response, with links to earlier coverage of the same events.
